items.prompt: What determines a bond's future coupon amount in the plain fixed-coupon model?

options.text: The last traded market price alone
options.why: Coupon contract and face/frequency determine promised coupons.

options.text: Face, coupon rate and payment convention
options.why: Market price can change without changing the promised coupon.

options.text: Face multiplied by the current yield to maturity
options.why: YTM is price-implied and can change without rewriting the fixed coupon contract.

options.text: The annual coupon amount at every payment date, regardless of frequency
options.why: The annual coupon must be split according to the payment convention.

items.explanation: Do not confuse the coupon contract with the price-implied yield.
